'''Matt Mariani''' was a Decipher staff member who met visitors at the front door of the 14 March 1997 [[Star Wars CCG Palace]] Grand Opening party.<ref name="party">[http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/index.html Special Events], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327205534/http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>
